tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This sits alongside the recorded rule of https everywhere with no exceptions, so connections are made over https and their certificates are verified in every build.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision.

It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, with no exemptions. It also notes the recorded https-everywhere rule, so connections use https and their certificates are checked in every build. It doesn't mention the retired decision that disabled verification in dev builds.

There was one conflict in the records. An earlier session's note said internal hosts would use plain http, but the current https-everywhere decision, which says "no exceptions", overrides it. I left the plain-http note out.

Muninn also reported a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That doesn't affect this file, but it means a hook is probably exceeding its timeout. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
